svg.text: EXP07 - why the trace is noisy and what the steady-rate peaks are
337 raw samples at 8 ms (125 Hz), exp07-sample.log
A Zoom of 0.40 s: the pattern repeats every 5 samples (dashed lines = 40 ms)
B Amplitude spectrum: the energy is at ~50 Hz mains (and its 25 Hz half)
C Same record after a 40 ms boxcar average (= 2 mains cycles): the 50/25 Hz peaks are gone, the slow motion remains
